name: Sportsbook-anchored sports and esports market making (devigged fair value, pair lock, outside hedge)
one_line: Rest tiered maker bids around devigged sharp-book prices on sports and long-tail esports; lock pairs under $1 or hedge residuals; freshness of odds decides PnL.
maturity: Established (large operator, pre-fee, self-reported); decayed for the small esports pair-lock bot
requires_ai: no; optional name mapping across books
edge: External sharp anchor vs thin Polymarket books; retail sports takers
capital: $1k-$10k long-tail esports; $10k+ major leagues ($300k for the pro)
opportunity_size: sports ~40% of volume; NFL pre-game already one price across 3 venues; long tail small
expected_results: esports bot +$4,973 on $95.8k over 4 months then ~$0; pro +$60-65k good month, -$100k bad 10 days (pre-fee)
competition: desks and US MM programmes in majors; 1c-overbidding bots in the long tail
flag: none on Polymarket; grey odds scraping and multi-wallet; insider lineup info prohibited
validate: 3-week paper log of devigged anchor vs book; pass fill rate >5% and positive settlement markout
top_risk: Stale odds and injury news fill you on the wrong side
solo_fit_reason: Cheap data and a clear external anchor make it testable in weeks, but the documented small bot decayed within four months and major-league pre-game lines are already arbitraged; viable only in niches with fresh feeds.
speed_class: latency-sensitive pre-game (odds freshness); latency-critical in play
min_capital: ~$2k: odds feed and VPS are fixed costs
capacity_ceiling: ~$10k-30k in long-tail esports before own bids set price
services: The Odds API or Pinnacle push feed
changes_made: Live 24 Sep: NFL/CFB game markets zero-fee (no rebate), other sports 0.05/15%; three-venue NFL prices within a tick.
Small esports sub-variant labelled decayed per critic note.
open_doubts: Pro operator's economics are pre-fee and self-reported.
Shin devig and 10.9 pp CoD figures read via the brief from the kacho post.
Auto-cancel at game start rests on a possibly stale official repo.
